data.name: HowToOrder
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the mail that explains how to order, and the heading at its top. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectAbout
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of its answer to INFO, which carries what the store has written about itself. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectPriceList
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the price list it sends in answer to PRICES. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectOrderNotUnderstood
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to an order in which nothing matched the price list. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectOrderOverLimit
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to an order that would take the buyer past the store's purchase limit. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectOrder
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of an order's confirmation, and of the mail that tells the buyer their order has moved on. {0} is the store's name, {1} the order's reference (six letters and digits).

data.name: SubjectNoOpenOrders
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to STATUS when the buyer has no open orders. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectOrderStatus
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to STATUS, which lists the buyer's orders. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectOrderNotFound
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to CANCEL when no order of theirs matches. {0} is the store's name.

data.name: SubjectOrderCancelled
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to CANCEL for one order. {0} is the store's name, {1} the order's reference.

data.name: SubjectOrdersCancelled
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of the answer to CANCEL for more than one order. {0} is the store's name, {1} the orders' references, separated by commas.

data.name: SubjectPart
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the subject of one mail of an answer too long for one, sent as several. {0} is the answer's subject, {1} this mail's number, {2} how many mails there are.

data.name: UsageSubjectWord
data.value: Put one of these words in the mail subject.
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: its first line, above the list of command words — PRICES, ORDER, STATUS, CANCEL, INFO and HELP — which stay in English, because the store reads the subject for exactly those words. Keep … around the word for subject.

data.name: UsagePrices
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: what the command word PRICES does, after "PRICES — ". PRICES itself stays in English.

data.name: UsageOrder
data.value: place an order, one item per line in the body.
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: what the command word ORDER does, after "ORDER — ". ORDER itself stays in English.

data.name: UsageDragIn
data.value: The easiest way is to drag the item in — from the price list, from the market, from your hangar — then put the quantity beside it if you want more than one.
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer, under ORDER: how to put an item in an order. Followed by two example items as links. Keep … around the words for dragging the item in.

data.name: UsageTyping
data.value: Typing the name works too. The quantity always goes AFTER the item:
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer, under ORDER. Followed by examples such as "Archon x2 Archon 2 Archon": the store reads the count after the item only, never before it.

data.name: UsageSomeoneElse
data.value: Sending it to someone else? Drag that character or corporation anywhere into the body and the contract will be made out to them instead of you.
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer, under ORDER: how to have the contract made out to another character or corporation. Keep … around the question.

data.name: UsageStatus
data.value: where your orders have got to.
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: what the command word STATUS does, after "STATUS — ". STATUS itself stays in English.

data.name: UsageStatusNoReference
data.value: No reference needed — you will get all of your open ones.
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer, under STATUS: an order's reference is not needed; without one the buyer is sent all their open orders.

data.name: UsageStatusOneOrder
data.value: To ask about one order, put its reference in the subject or the body:
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer, under STATUS. Followed by the example "STATUS 3FVPA9".

data.name: UsageCancel
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: what the command word CANCEL does, after "CANCEL — ". CANCEL itself stays in English.

data.name: UsageCancelReference
data.value: This one always needs its reference, from the confirmation mail. Subject or body, either works:
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer, under CANCEL: cancelling needs the order's reference, in the subject or the body. Followed by the example "CANCEL 3FVPA9".

data.name: UsageInfo
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: what the command word INFO does, after "INFO — ". INFO itself stays in English.

data.name: UsageHelp
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: what the command word HELP does, after "HELP — " — it sends this mail. HELP itself stays in English.

data.name: UsagePricesNote
data.value: Prices are those on the list at the moment your order is read. — {0}
data.comment: A store's how-to-order mail to a buyer: its last line. {0} is the store's name, signing the mail.

data.name: NotRecognised
data.value: I did not recognise that as an order.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the first line of the how-to-order mail sent when their mail had none of the command words in its subject.

data.name: NothingMatched
data.value: Nothing on this order matched the price list.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the first line of the answer to an order in which nothing matched the store's price list.

data.name: NotFound
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering an order that matched nothing: what they asked for that is not on the price list. {0} is what the buyer wrote, separated by commas.

data.name: OverLimitNotTaken
data.value: This order is over the store's purchase limit, so it was not taken.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the first line of the answer to an order that would take them past the store's purchase limit. Followed by the sum that says why (LimitOver) and the rule (LimitRule).

data.name: OrderReceived
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of an order's confirmation. {0} is the order's reference (six letters and digits).

data.name: PriceEach
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation and status: after a line's total, when there is more than one, the price of one. {0} is the price with its unit, such as "1,200,000 ISK".

data.name: IskAmount
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: every amount of ISK in an order's confirmation, status and cancellation. {0:N0} is the amount, already grouped the language's way. Keep ISK; put it where the language's EVE client does, with the space the language uses before a unit (French: a no-break space).

data.name: OrderTotalLine
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the line under an order's confirmation that adds it up. {0} is the sum with its unit, such as "2,400,000 ISK".

data.name: ContractMadeOutTo
data.value: Contract will be made out to {0}.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation: who the contract will go to. {0} is a character's or corporation's name. Keep … around it.

data.name: NotOrdered
data.value: Not on the list, so NOT ordered: {0}
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, in red: what they asked for that is not on the price list and was left out of the order. {0} is what the buyer wrote, separated by commas.

data.name: OrderTrimmed
data.value: This order was larger than one mail may place — at most {0} items, {1:N0} of each — and has been reduced to fit. Check the lines above, and mail us directly for anything bigger.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, in red: the order was cut down to what one mail may place. {0} is the most items one mail may order (40), {1} the most of each one (10,000).

data.name: ReplyWithStatus
data.value: Send STATUS for progress, or CANCEL and this reference to withdraw it.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the last line of an order's confirmation. Keep STATUS and CANCEL in English: they are the words the buyer must write in the subject. "Send", not "reply": a reply's subject starts "Re:", and the store leaves those for a person.

data.name: NoOpenOrders
data.value: You have no open orders with us.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the answer to STATUS when they have no open orders, above how to order.

data.name: OrderHeading
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of the answer to STATUS about the orders they named. {0} is the order's reference, or several separated by commas.

data.name: YourOpenOrders
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of the answer to STATUS when they named no order, which lists every open one.

data.name: ContractTo
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS, under an order: who its contract goes to. {0} is a character's or corporation's name.

data.name: OrderTotal
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS, under an order of several items: what it comes to. {0} is the sum with its unit, such as "2,400,000 ISK".

data.name: NoOrderMatches
data.value: No open order of yours matches {0}.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering CANCEL: no order of theirs has the reference they gave. {0} is what they wrote that looked like a reference. Keep … around it.

data.name: NoReferenceFound
data.value: I could not find an order reference in that mail.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering CANCEL: their mail held nothing that looked like an order's reference.

data.name: ReferencesLookLike
data.value: References look like K7P2QX and are in the confirmation mail. Send STATUS on its own to list your open orders.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering CANCEL when no order matched. Keep the example reference K7P2QX as it is, and STATUS in English: it is the word the buyer must write in the subject. "Send", not "reply": a reply's subject starts "Re:", and the store leaves those for a person.

data.name: OrderCancelled
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of the answer to CANCEL for one order. {0} is the order's reference.

data.name: OrdersCancelled
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of the answer to CANCEL for more than one order. {0} is the orders' references, separated by commas.

data.name: NothingOpenToCancelSingle
data.value: Nothing on this order was still open to cancel.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering CANCEL for one order: everything on it was already delivered or cancelled.

data.name: NothingOpenToCancelSeveral
data.value: Nothing on these orders was still open to cancel.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering CANCEL for more than one order: everything on them was already delivered or cancelled.

data.name: LinesLeftAsTheyAreOther
data.value: {0} line(s) were already delivered or cancelled and have been left as they are.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, answering CANCEL: the lines of the orders that could not be cancelled any more. {0} is how many. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by count adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: UpdateHeading
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, sent unasked when an order moves on — a job started, a contract made out: its heading. {0} is the order's reference. Keep … around it.

data.name: TypeFallback
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: an item the app has no name for, in place of its name. {0} is the item's type id, a number.

data.name: UnknownLink
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, among what their order asked for that is not on the price list: an item link with no name on it. {0} is the item's type id, a number.

data.name: PageOf
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of one mail of a price list too long for one. {0} is this mail's number, {1} how many there are.

data.name: HeadingPart
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the heading of one mail of an answer too long for one. {0} is the answer's heading, {1} this mail's number, {2} how many there are.

data.name: PagesDidNotFitOther
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the end of the last mail of an answer longer than the store will send at once (a price list, or a buyer's orders). {0} is how many more mails it would have taken; they are not sent, and asking again sends the same first ones. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by count adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: StatusOneOrderHint
data.value: Send STATUS with an order reference to ask about one order.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the line under PagesDidNotFit when the answer cut short was a list of the buyer's orders. Keep STATUS in English: it is the word the buyer must write in the subject.

data.name: MessageCut
data.value: … this message was too long for EVE mail and has been cut here.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: the end of a mail that had to be cut short to fit EVE mail's length limit.

data.name: ExpectContractWaiting
data.value: A contract is already waiting for you to accept.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — a contract for it is already made out to them.

data.name: ExpectInStock
data.value: In stock and reserved for you — you will be notified when the contract has been created.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — it is on the shelf, with no date yet for the contract.

data.name: ExpectInStockDue
data.value: In stock and reserved for you — contract expected {0}.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — it is on the shelf. {0} is the date the contract is expected, as 2026-09-28.

data.name: ExpectInBuild
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — it is being built, with no date yet.

data.name: ExpectInBuildDue
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — it is being built. {0} is the date it is expected, as 2026-09-28.

data.name: ExpectOutOfStock
data.value: Out of stock — your reservation is placed, and you will be told the completion date once the build starts.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — none on the shelf and none being built yet.

data.name: ExpectOutOfStockDue
data.value: Out of stock — your reservation is placed, expected {0}.
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in an order's confirmation, under an item: what happens next — none on the shelf. {0} is the date it is expected, as 2026-09-28.

data.name: StateDelivered
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — delivered.

data.name: StateDeliveredRestCancelledOther
data.value: {0:N0} of {1:N0} delivered, and the rest cancelled
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — part delivered, the rest cancelled. {0} is how many were delivered, {1} how many were ordered. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by {0} adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: StateContractDeclined
data.value: the contract was declined, so this order is closed
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — they declined its contract, which closed the order.

data.name: StateCancelled
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — cancelled.

data.name: StateContractWaiting
data.value: contract created — waiting for you to accept it
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — a contract is made out to them.

data.name: StateReadyContractDue
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — on the shelf. {0} is the date the contract is expected, as 2026-09-28.

data.name: StateReady
data.value: ready now — you will be notified when the contract has been created
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — on the shelf, with no date yet for the contract.

data.name: StateInProductionDue
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — being built. {0} is the date it is expected, as 2026-09-28.

data.name: StateInProduction
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — being built, with no date yet.

data.name: StateExpected
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — not started, but with a date. {0} is the date it is expected, as 2026-09-28.

data.name: StateWaitingOnMaterials
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update, after an item: where it has got to — nothing on the shelf and nothing being built yet.

data.name: PartDeliveredOther
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update: one part of an item that is part way there, as in "1 of 2 delivered; 1 in production". {0} is how many were delivered, {1} how many were ordered. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by {0} adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: PartOnContractOther
data.value: {0:N0} on a contract waiting for you to accept it
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update: one part of an item that is part way there. {0} is how many are on a contract made out to them. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by count adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: PartReadyOther
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update: one part of an item that is part way there. {0} is how many are on the shelf. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by count adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update: one part of an item that is part way there. {0} is how many are on the shelf, {1} the date the contract is expected, as 2026-09-28. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by {0} adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: PartInProductionOther

data.name: PartInProductionDueOther
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update: one part of an item that is part way there. {0} is how many are being built, {1} the date they are expected, as 2026-09-28. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by {0} adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: PartWaitingOnMaterialsOther

data.name: PartExpectedOther
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer, in the answer to STATUS and in an order's update: one part of an item that is part way there. {0} is how many are not started, {1} the date they are expected, as 2026-09-28. English keeps one form for every count; a language that needs forms by {0} adds them (…One, …Few, …Many).

data.name: PartsSeparator
data.comment: A store's mail to a buyer: what goes between the parts of an item that is part way there, as in "1 of 2 delivered; 1 in production". Your language's own separator, with the space after it where it takes one.

data.name: LimitScopeItem
data.comment: A store's purchase limit, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen: what the limit counts over, placed in LimitRule and LimitOver as {1} — so many units of each item.

data.name: LimitScopeGroup
data.comment: A store's purchase limit, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen: what the limit counts over, placed in LimitRule and LimitOver as {1} — so many units of each item group (all frigates, all battleships…).

data.name: LimitScopeStore
data.comment: A store's purchase limit, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen: what the limit counts over, placed in LimitRule and LimitOver as {1} — so many units of anything in the store, all together.

data.name: LimitPerDay
data.comment: A store's purchase limit, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen: the period it counts over, placed in LimitRule and LimitOver as {2}.

data.name: LimitPerDaysOther
data.comment: A store's purchase limit, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen: the period it counts over, placed in LimitRule and LimitOver as {2}. {0} is the number of days, two or more (one is LimitPerDay).

data.name: LimitPerMonth

data.name: LimitPerYearsOther

data.name: LimitEver

data.name: LimitRuleOne
data.comment: A store's purchase limit in a sentence, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen. {0} is the number of units (one), {1} what it counts over (LimitScopeItem…), {2} the period (LimitPerDay…, LimitEver).

data.name: LimitRuleOther
data.comment: A store's purchase limit in a sentence, read by its buyers in mail and by its owner on the Stores screen. {0} is the number of units, {1} what it counts over (LimitScopeItem…), {2} the period (LimitPerDay…, LimitEver).

data.name: LimitOver
data.value: Over the store's limit of {0:N0} {1} {2}: {3:N0} × {4} on top of {5:N0} already ordered.

data.name: PriceListLimitReached
